content.text:
I fixed one problem on the pricing page: the "Most popular" ribbon on the Pro plan was hidden. It had `z-index: -1` in `site/css/pages.css`, which put it behind the card's background. I changed it to `z-index: 1`, so it should now show at the top edge of the card.

The 16 functional tests pass. I didn't load the page in a browser to look at it, and the tests don't check how the ribbon looks.

I didn't find anything else wrong in the pricing markup or the plan styles. If something else looks off to you, tell me what you're seeing.

STATUS: DONE
